components.gap: The finite dependent-source set (48 references, checked against the source's list on pp.344-345) is fixed in def:p15-w02b-p15-039-dependent-set, and most promised proofs and claims are accounted (rank laws and converse, conditional axiomatization, deductive reasons, uniqueness of conditionalization, possibility/consonant equivalence, DS divergence, probability translation, Levi/Harper, independence, measurement theorem disclaimed, empirical studies). Not accounted on the route: (1) the source's formal claim (p.342, txt lines 403-405) that all belief changes shown in its section 3 are c-revisions, and its claim that ranking theory is one of the few frameworks expressive enough for a precise formalization of conditional preservation supporting both belief change and inductive reasoning (txt lines 355-361); rationality-5-3.tex 623-627 mentions c-revisions/c-representations but neither verifies these claims nor marks them as unverified attributions. (2) The descriptive/evaluative claims of section 5 that ranking functions are among the most popular KRR formalisms with increasing popularity (txt lines 302-305) and that System Z is one of the best and most convenient approaches (txt lines 339-342) are given no kind or evidence status, unlike the parallel Bayesian-boom claim (w02b-p15-039 file 176-185). (3) The dependent-source set is fixed in the follow-on chapter, after rationality-5-3.tex has already authored claims on the route; that it was fixed before authoring cannot be confirmed from the text.
